entries.title: Bas Rutten stops Masakatsu Funaki at the Pancrase anniversary show
entries.detail: Rutten defeated Funaki in the 1996 Anniversary Show main event in Tokyo, retaining the King of Pancrase crown after a brutal 17-minute fight.

entries.title: Josh Barnett wins the SuperBrawl 13 heavyweight tournament
